name: Omatase! Janbaraya♪
source:
Main character learns about a mahjong-dedicated town at some internet site. He finds nothing at the sort upon arrival, though. He starts to play mahjong with the waitresses of the family restaurant. However, there is a mysterious person who operates girls' actions...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-june-2005-ayakashibito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角在网上了解到一个专门的麻将镇。然而到达后却发现根本没有那样的地方。他开始和家庭餐厅的女服务员们打麻将。但是，有一个神秘人在操纵着女孩们的行动……

[出自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-june-2005-ayakashibito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
